title: Eight exchanges on two flows have no row in the 2025 flow list
datasets: 304227 Polystyrene, expandable, at plant (RER): `Nitrogen dioxide, RAF` to air; seven RER eco-profiles: `Uranium` to water
observation: Counted by name and compartment, 8 of 293,747 elementary exchanges have no row in the flow list (`SetupDatabase_file.CSV` of the BAFU:2025 SimaPro import guide; the 2026 download has no such file): it has no `Nitrogen dioxide, RAF` and lists waterborne uranium only by isotope. For 2026 the uranium gap is in that 2025 file, not in the release: the release's openLCA package has `Uranium` to water in kg with all seven amounts. Only the RAF name is a real difference, and the package carries that row as `Nitrogen dioxide`. 304227 has no `Nitrogen oxides` row while 13 of the 14 datasets from its generator do, so the row looks like its NOx under a name nothing else uses, and the published `Main air pollutants and PM` appears not to count it. Refines F4, which counted by name.
validation_scope: Every elementary exchange of the ecoSpold XML matched on name and compartment against the 2025 flow list (SetupDatabase_file.CSV of the BAFU:2025 SimaPro import guide; the 2026 download has no such file); the release's openLCA package read on 6 November for all 7 uranium exchanges (kg) and the 304227 row. Filed 31 October 2026. Not yet re-measured by a second person.
next_action: Independent re-measurement (drop needs-triage), then send to BAFU with the next batch.
